name: update-skills
description: Update every subhan-skills plugin to the latest marketplace version in both Claude Code and Codex, via each CLI's native plugin commands.

interface.shortDescription: Pull the newest subhan-skills plugin versions into Claude Code and Codex.
interface.longDescription: Wraps update-skills.sh: refreshes the subhan-skills marketplace in each CLI, updates each installed Claude plugin at its own scope, upgrades the Codex marketplace snapshot, and reports per-plugin version changes.
